description: This Java test class 'ModuleExtensionsTest' contains unit tests for the 'Module' class's getExtensions() method in the OpenMRS project. It verifies behaviors related to extension point handling, class loading, and error scenarios within the module extension system.

classes.name: ModuleExtensionsTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of extension handling within the Module class in OpenMRS.

classes.name: AccessibleExtension
classes.description: A static inner class extending Extension used for testing the expansion of extension classes.

classes.name: AnotherAccessibleExtension
classes.description: Another static inner class extending Extension for testing behavioral changes when extension classes are replaced.

classes.name: ExtensionCausingIllegalAccessException
classes.description: A static inner class extending Extension designed to simulate illegal access scenarios when expanding extensions.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method annotated with @BeforeEach that initializes the Module instance before each test.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Cleanup method annotated with @AfterEach that invalidates module class loaders after each test.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotExpandIfExtensionNamesAreNull
methods.description: Test to verify that getExtensions() returns an empty list when extension names are null.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotExpandIfExtensionNamesAreEmpty
methods.description: Test to verify that getExtensions() returns an empty list when extension names are empty.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotExpandIfNoModuleClassloaderIsFound
methods.description: Test to verify behavior when no class loader is found for the module, expecting empty list.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotFailExpandingAnExtensionNameCausingANoClassDefinitionFoundError
methods.description: Test to verify that getExtensions() handles NoClassDefFoundError gracefully when an extension class is missing.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotFailExpandingAClassWhichCannotBeFound
methods.description: Test to verify that getExtensions() returns empty list if the class cannot be found in class loader.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotFailExpandingAClassWhichCannotBeInstantiated
methods.description: Test to verify that getExtensions() handles instantiation errors gracefully.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotFailExpandingAClassWhichCannotAccessed
methods.description: Test to verify that getExtensions() handles illegal access errors gracefully.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldExpandClassNamesIntoClassInstances
methods.description: Test to verify that extension class names are expanded into class instances properly.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldNotExpandAgainIfClassNamesMatch
methods.description: Test to verify that getExtensions() does not re-expand extensions if the class names are unchanged.

methods.name: getExtensions_shouldExpandAgainIfExtensionNamesNowHaveADifferentClassOnSameExtensionPoint
methods.description: Test to ensure that getExtensions() re-expands extensions when extension class names are changed.

methods.name: registerModuleClassLoader
methods.description: Helper method to set up and register a ModuleClassLoader for testing purposes.
